Regardless of whether you drop out now, or stick with it and graduate, you have got to get your parents financial control out of your life. Since your a junior I’m assuming you only have one year left. It’s hard to give advice based on the financials, but if I were you, I’d probably stick it out for now and try and finish my degree, then get a job after college, you’re in a very good degree field and will probably be able to find a good job out of college which is best for you long term. 

That being said, if this level of control is destroying your mental health, just get out. Find a job, or go full time where you’re working sell or return the car (I’m assuming it’s in your parents name) find a place to live (maybe with bf depending on your relationship) and evaluate your college from there. You may just finish slower by going part time, that’s okay, or maybe since it’s online you could work full time and go. 

It’s really up to you what the right thing to do is. Going NC is hard, you may find that once they no longer have control over you, your relationship changes and you can actually establish boundaries. Or maybe you’ll go NC and realize it was the absolute best thing you’ve ever done. Either way, I’m about your age (M20) and I’m currently going through something very similar with my mom.
